built: Implements light-ticket budget checking at 150-line cap via ticket_lane() and light_diff_lines() reading lane and counting insertions plus deletions, with stop_light_over_budget() superseding over-budget tickets on base. Budget check runs after build but before CI, blocking progression for tickets exceeding cap. All ACs held; CI green.
review: Ship. All ACs held (AC-1–AC-4, charter-1). Runner.py adds 150-line budget cap with check after build before CI; tests cover with split fixture. Two warns: lane marking could diverge between branch and base (low impact); no plan-walk test for exit-2 light stop (medium impact).
